A cavernous '''warehouse''' that contained medical supplies was tended by an elderly [[Unidentified medical supply merchant|man]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulta]]. [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]] purchased a [[Repulsorlift chair/Legends|hoverchair]] for his crippled daughter, [[Arra Yooms]], from the man at the warehouse<ref name="Deceived" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the end of the [[Great Galactic War]], which was concurrent with Zeerid Korr's trip to Vulta per ''The Old Republic: Deceived'', occurred in [[3653 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The warehouse appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', written by [[Paul S. Kemp]].<ref name="Deceived" />
